subject: Top-down 65% keyboard layout outline for the Wuque Studio Ikki68 Aurora renewed-interest piece. The compact alpha block (no F-row), a narrow right-side four-key nav column, and an inverted-T arrow cluster together read as the 65% layout's defining silhouette. The case fill departs from the family's usual flat opaque case: a blurred splash-tinted haze sits behind the outline, the interior fill is a low-opacity milk-glass gradient rather than a flat fill, a fine scattered-dot grain pattern covers the case, and three soft blurred diagonal bands cross the interior — together evoking the Ikki68 Aurora's translucent/frosted polycarbonate shell. A closing glyph beneath the case (three concentric arcs fading outward to a single focal dot) nods to the Aurora finish name and the article's renewed-spotlight framing.
